description: Runway ends. PROVISIONAL DRAFT 24-10-2026: magnetic headings from public sources (SkyVector), not yet checked against the AIP. Melbourne has two runways, not parallel pairs: 16/34 (the main, about 3,657 m) and 09/27 (about 2,286 m). Wind direction and heading share one reference (OD-11), so headings are entered in the magnetic reference the weather reports use.
source: SkyVector, 24-10-2026. Threshold coordinates (latitude and longitude, decimal degrees): OurAirports open data (community data), retrieved 26-10-2026, applied at the owner's instruction; not checked against the AIP.
